component.name: Keymasq
component.summary: Linux input remapper for keyboards, mice, and gamepads

description.p: Keymasq is a Linux input remapper built around a privileged daemon, a per-user session broker, and a GTK4 GUI.
It supports global layered profiles, per-device mappings, window-aware profile activation, macros, superkeys, and multi-step combos.
Expands superkey pattern actions and macro payloads, resolves nested macro refresh issues, tightens rapidfire validation, and keeps hold-macro mouse suppression in sync.
Adds first-class Niri support and expands superkeys with pattern/overload modes plus value-aware bindings.
Improves first-run setup with an editable default profile and a cleaner device setup flow.
